decision: Do not start broad PMXT/Polymarket L2 backfill. The current code proves a bounded one-off selected-source path and records several fail-fast guardrails, but broad backfill still lacks accepted source proof, accepted expanded coverage/cost/storage evidence, and an L2 source-proof tick-size policy: either dynamic timed instrument-epoch replay or a source-proof-bound no-tick-size-change universe.

root_cause.previous_slow_backfill_failure_mode: Large hourly PMXT Parquet objects were treated as payloads to scan, hash, or stage before the acceptance gates proved a bounded source/window/instrument scope.
why_repeating_it_is_unsafe: PMXT v2 hourly objects are hundreds of MB and can contain tens of millions of rows, so full-object work scales poorly across broad windows.
The accepted source proof is still pending; payload work before source acceptance can produce expensive artifacts that cannot become canonical.
Standard pinned NT BacktestNode catalog replay does not currently expose timed InstrumentAny instrument-definition replay, so full L2 over tick-size-changing assets would overclaim correctness.
root_cause.current_bounded_improvement: The current one-off selector path records source_row_groups in the event-count ledger and selector report, first_proof_event_count_ledger rejects sources above TOML-owned max_source_parquet_bytes before Parquet reader construction, selected_source_slice rejects sources above TOML-owned max_source_parquet_bytes before full-file hashing, selected_source_slice projects only the selector row groups with ParquetRecordBatchReaderBuilder.with_row_groups, and backfill_execution_plan now requires TOML-owned max_source_rows, max_projected_row_groups, max_wall_seconds, and matching source_usage_scope before it can emit a ready plan.
root_cause.remaining_efficiency_gap: The bounded first-proof event-count ledger still performs a two-column scan only when the configured source byte budget admits it. Broad planning still must not use this as a discovery mechanism across many PMXT objects; it needs accepted manifest/index-owned coverage and actual row-group/predicate metadata before payload work. Current code can carry and require that metadata once accepted source proof provides it, and it can carry source_usage_scope through the pre-payload gate chain once PMXT has an accepted canonical source proof.

polymarket_official_api.observed_2026_06_09: Official Polymarket APIs include Gamma, Data, and CLOB. Gamma/Data are public; CLOB has public orderbook/pricing endpoints and trading endpoints that require authentication.
polymarket_official_api.historical_l2_limit: The official prices-history endpoint returns price history with t/p pairs and minute fidelity, not full historical L2 order book replay.

pmxt_archive.observed_2026_06_09: PMXT v2 is an hourly Parquet archive of Polymarket CLOB market WebSocket events from every live asset.
pmxt_archive.current_index_sample: 2026-06-08 hourly objects listed around 451.5 MB to 603.6 MB.

canonical_object_head_probe.finding: The bounded one-hour proof source is a 361 MB object and supports byte ranges. Broad planning must use source-proof/index/range/row-group metadata before payload work; full-object scans are acceptable only inside explicitly bounded accepted tranches.

local_sources.evidence: PolymarketDataClient is a live market data client: it handles WebSocket book snapshots, price_change deltas, last_trade_price TradeTicks, tick_size_change instrument rebuilds, and Gamma instrument discovery.
PolymarketDataApiHttpClient fetches public historical trades and converts them to TradeTick, with an offset ceiling warning; it is not a full historical L2 order book archive reader.
Pinned NT live Polymarket emits rebuilt instruments for tick-size changes, but standard BacktestNode catalog replay does not expose timed InstrumentAny replay.

nt_surface_evidence.current_split: Use NT for model types, Polymarket parser/provider surfaces, ParquetDataCatalog, and BacktestNode. Keep Bolt-owned code limited to source-proof gating, artifact provenance, and raw historical source adapters where NT has no batch source reader.

bounded_row_group_projection.evidence: selector_source_row_groups requires selected_assets[].source_row_groups, validates bounds against Parquet metadata, and selected_source_slice builds the reader with with_row_groups(matching_row_groups.row_groups).
selected_source_slice_uses_selector_row_groups_without_full_asset_rescan proves the selected-source stage succeeds when the non-selected row group contains an unscannable null asset value.
The refreshed one-off report records source_row_groups=62, projected_row_groups=1, selected_rows=5, selected_asset_count=1.

bounded_full_object_work.evidence: build_first_proof_event_count_ledger_from_parquet now requires TOML-owned max_source_parquet_bytes, stats the source file, and rejects oversized source parquet before Parquet reader construction.
first_proof_event_count_ledger_rejects_source_above_configured_byte_budget_before_output proves the event-count ledger refuses an oversized source before writing output.

write_selected_source_slice now requires TOML-owned max_source_parquet_bytes, stats the source file, and rejects oversized source parquet before source_parquet_sha256 full-file hashing or output/report creation.
selected_source_slice_rejects_source_above_configured_byte_budget_before_output failed RED when max_source_parquet_bytes was unknown, then passed GREEN after the pre-hash byte-budget guard.

no_download_coverage_gate.evidence: The committed coverage ledger status proves source-proof metadata and coverage_axis can be derived without payload download, and now source-fences the indexed PMXT manifest/index snapshot: 1,351 order_book_snapshot_deltas objects, 1,351 verified HEADs, 557,815,904,970 compressed bytes, and the 2026-04-13T19:00:00Z to 2026-06-10T15:00:00Z archive window. Both PMXT ledger records remain rejected because source_proof_status is pending.

accepted_tranche_budget_gate.evidence: BackfillExecutionPlanSpec now carries max_source_rows, max_projected_row_groups, and max_wall_seconds; evaluate_backfill_execution_plan blocks zero values before returning a ready plan.
execution_plan_blocks_missing_work_budgets_before_payload_fetch covers the pre-payload rejection path without venue-specific literals.
The committed accepted-tranche execution-plan spec records explicit source-row, projected-row-group, and wall-time budgets while preserving the existing materialized run-spec hash.

object_selection_metadata_gate.evidence: BackfillSourceProofScopeObject now preserves optional source_row_groups or row_groups arrays and predicate_ref from manifest payload objects.
BackfillAcceptedTrancheObject now carries source_row_groups and predicate_ref from the selected source-proof-scope object into the accepted tranche manifest.

BackfillExecutionPlanObject now carries source_row_groups and predicate_ref from the accepted tranche, and require_object_selection_metadata can block ready execution plans with ExecutionPlanObjectSelectionMetadataMissing before payload fetch.
source_proof_scope_preserves_object_selection_metadata proves manifest-owned selection metadata is retained by the source-proof scope report.
accepted_tranche_carries_object_selection_metadata proves selected source-proof metadata survives accepted-tranche materialization.

execution_plan_carries_object_selection_metadata and execution_plan_blocks_required_object_selection_metadata_before_payload_fetch prove propagation into execution plans plus the opt-in fail-closed guard.
The Binance reference-artifact parity test passes with require_object_selection_metadata defaulting false, preserving existing accepted native trade gates.

source_usage_scope_pre_payload_gate.evidence: BackfillSourceProofScopeReport exposes the source proof usage_scope so canonical_backfill_input and one_off_backfill_data provenance are visible before payload fetch.
BackfillAcceptedTrancheManifest carries source_usage_scope from the selected source-proof-scope report into the accepted tranche artifact.
Backfill run-spec materialization writes the accepted tranche source_usage_scope into source_proof.usage_scope in the materialized TOML run spec.
BackfillExecutionRunBinding and BackfillExecutionPlan carry source_usage_scope, and execution planning blocks tranche/run-spec mismatches with RunSpecSourceUsageScopeMismatch before payload fetch.
source_proof_scope_exposes_and_blocks_one_off_usage_scope proves one-off source proofs remain blocked while exposing their source_usage_scope in the scope report.
execution_plan_blocks_run_spec_usage_scope_mismatch_before_payload_fetch proves execution plans fail closed when materialized run-spec scope drifts from the accepted tranche.
materialized_run_spec_carries_accepted_tranche_usage_scope_before_payload_fetch failed RED when TOML omitted usage_scope, then passed after materialization copied the accepted tranche scope.

required_before_any_broad_backfill: Accept a durable Polymarket SourceProofReport for the exact source/window/table_family.
Keep the first gate manifest/index-only: coverage, freshness, completeness, bytes, object count, and cost must be recorded before payload download.
Replace broad full-object hashing in planning/projection with accepted object hashes from staging or Artifact Index records; full payload reads belong only inside bounded accepted tranches.

Carry object-level row-group or predicate metadata from the accepted source proof into the execution plan so selected-source projection does not rediscover it by rescanning payloads; current code carries source_row_groups/predicate_ref and can require them, but accepted PMXT source-proof manifests with that metadata remain unproven.

Carry source_usage_scope from accepted source proof through source-proof scope, accepted tranche, materialized run-spec, and execution plan; current code does this and blocks run-spec mismatches, but PMXT still lacks accepted canonical source proof.

Reject source-only venue-scale acceptance when an explicit source proof set has zero accepted proofs; current code enforces this guardrail, but PMXT full-current still has source_accepted_proof_count=0 and remains blocked.

Set explicit object byte, row count, projected row-group count, and wall-time budgets in the accepted tranche plan; backfill_execution_plan now carries row, projected-row-group, and wall-time budgets, while first_proof_event_count_ledger and selected_source_slice enforce source parquet byte budgets before payload-scale work.

Prove dynamic tick-size replay through NT BacktestNode/catalog, or accept a source-proof-bound no-tick-size-change exclusion policy before full L2 replay claims; generic SourceProofReport L2Replay acceptance now requires l2_replay_evidence.no_tick_size_change_universe_ref or l2_replay_evidence.timed_instrument_epoch_replay_ref.
Use GitHub CI as the broad verification gate for committed changes; avoid broad local cargo test runs as the default verification path.
claim_limits: This artifact does not accept PMXT as a durable source.
This artifact does not authorize broad PMXT/Polymarket backfill.
This artifact does not prove expanded coverage, exact broad cost, or production throughput.
This artifact does not prove dynamic tick-size replay.
